usedFor: Shopify holds the store's products, and Zoho WorkDrive receives a folder for each through “Create Folder”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Folder” in Zoho WorkDrive
bestTemplate.why: Each new product gets its own folder, ready for files.

watchOut: “Create Folder” in Zoho WorkDrive makes a new folder on every run, so duplicate runs mean duplicate folders.
